mentions.name: Raspberry Pi eBook server
mentions.description: This is a self-hosted eBook server running on a Raspberry Pi with Node.js. It serves a library of PDFs over the network and allows downloading a specific page range of a book, built to work around iCloud's inability to download the author's nearly 1 GB book library.
mentions.problem: iCloud could not download the books, and the entire library is almost 1 GB.
mentions.audience: Self-hosted for the author's own book library and reading needs.
mentions.source_excerpt: An eBook sever on raspberry pi running nodejs. I had a lot of issues with iCloud not being able to download my books, plus my entire library is almost 1 GB. So, my solution is to serve a list of PDFs over node and allow download of a specific page range.
